claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation equipment predicate / holding gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Activated magic-item abilities need a deterministic requirement analogous to PassiveMechanics.condition so the surface can express that the item must be held while its activation is used.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Fireball from it."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: qualified attunement requirement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: MagicItemRecord needs an attunement qualifier beyond a bare boolean so authored items can express eligibility restrictions such as attunement by a spellcaster.
